title: Can Apple make smart glasses that aren’t a constant privacy threat?
summary: As Apple prepares to launch its first smart glasses, the company is also wrestling with how to address consumer privacy concerns, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman . That could be a bigger issue for Apple, which constantly emphasizes privacy in its marketing.
